description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
2027 Overview
Summer associates will be immersed in AbbVie’s in-house legal and compliance teams, learning about and handling real-world matters under the supervision of AbbVie attorneys and compliance officers. Summer associates will work with one of the following departments within the in-house legal or compliance team for the duration of the summer internship:
Patent Legal Academy
Work on a wide variety of patent prosecution and IP (patent, trade secret) litigation-related tasks, which may include drafting materials for U.S. and foreign patent prosecution, listing patents in the FDA’s Orange Book, analyzing freedom-to-operate issues, addressing contractual issues, evaluating issues related to biopharmaceutical patent and trade secret litigation, and participating in strategy meetings with in-house and outside prosecution and litigation counsel.
Clinical R&D Legal Academy
Work on a wide range of clinical trial-related legal and regulatory matters in support of AbbVie’s therapeutic pipeline. Provides support for AbbVie’s global clinical research-based pharmaceutical business, including: clinical trial design; executing transactions required to get a clinical trial up and running, conducting legal analysis relating to patient-related matters such as informed consent, recruitment and retention strategies, and integration of novel technologies into AbbVie’s clinical trials; and providing global regulatory advice relating to AbbVie’s pipeline programs.
Corporate Legal Academy
Work in key corporate legal areas such as corporate financing, securities compliance and disclosure, compensation and benefits, and corporate governance.
Strategic Transactions Academy
Substantive legal work related to acquisition transactions as well as new and existing collaborations; assessing antitrust risks associated with mergers, acquisitions, and licensing transactions; and venture capital transactions.
Global Commercial Legal Academy
Support comprehensive legal and strategic guidance to Marketing, Sales, Medical Affairs, and Regulatory Affairs teams. Advise on a broad range of matters involving the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), Federal Trade Commission (FTC), Office of Inspector General (OIG), and other applicable laws, regulations, and industry guidance relevant to our business.t various pharmaceutical and aesthetics brands by partnering with attorneys to deliver
Operations, Privacy, and Technology Academy
Support the Operations function, which is responsible for AbbVie’s product manufacturing, procurement of goods and services, quality assurance, supply chain, and various aspects of product development; support the Legal Privacy team; and work on various Legal Technology projects, including those related to AI and the use of data across the enterprise.
Litigation/Employment/Compliance Academy
Work alongside attorneys across AbbVie’s Commercial Litigation, Employment, Labor & Immigration, and Legal Compliance teams.  Opportunity to work across a broad array of litigation and counseling matters, including areas such as product liability, antitrust, contractual disputes, visa and other immigration issues, and compliance with relevant laws including the Anti-Kickback Statute, Food, Drug & Cosmetic Act, Foreign Corrupt Practices Act, and many others.
Office of Ethics and Compliance Academy
Gain hands-on experience by supporting the Compliance team in activities such as conducting policy assessments, developing and supporting training initiatives, monitoring business practices and participating in investigations to help promote compliant conduct under healthcare and pharmaceutical industry codes, laws, and regulations. This role will also involve cross-functional collaboration with teams in Operations, Commercial Brands, R&D, Privacy, and International.
***
All summer associates will research and present on a legal or compliance issue related to their work and will have the opportunity to meet and work with AbbVie’s in-house and outside counsel and compliance professionals, including partnering closely with both a manager and mentor who will both provide ongoing guidance and professional development.
By the end of the summer, AbbVie 1L Summer Associates should have attained:
practical experience working for a global biopharmaceutical company in an interesting and evolving area of law,
an understanding of how in-house attorneys and compliance officers provide value to their company as trusted advisors to the business,
leadership opportunities and experience building business relationships effectively, and
meaningful writing and communication development.
How to Apply
Submit your application, which includes your resume and related information at the AbbVie Career Site AND Email a single PDF consisting of the documents set forth below to AbbVieLegalAcademy@abbvie.com.
Current resume
A letter explaining your interest in the AbbVie 1L Legal Academy Program, including your ranking of your top three choices among the internship programs listed above.

Undergraduate transcript (unofficial)

description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Drug Substance Engineering Internship Overview
Envision spending your summer working with energetic colleagues and inspirational leaders, all while gaining world-class experience in one of the most dynamic organizations in the pharmaceutical industry. This is a reality for AbbVie Interns.
Micronization of drug substance is a critical process in API manufacturing for ensuring downstream critical quality attributes. Micronization processes such as pin milling and jet milling leverage feed rate control to optimize the process performance, and while feed rate is well understood for many powder systems there is a gap in understanding the feed rate control of poorly flowing materials in micronization techniques.
The Drug Substance Engineering Intern within Product Development, Science, and Technology (PDS&T) will help establish a systematic approach to understand how the physical properties of powder systems impact their feeding performance in micronization processes.
Key responsibilities include:
Experimental studies to understand and characterize powder properties
Evaluate performance of micronization techniques (i.e. jet mill, pin mill) with various feed mechanisms
Analyze data and trends to identify signatures for process performance
Develop and verify computational models
Summarize and present findings in departmental and cross-functional settings
Minimum Qualifications
Currently enrolled in university, pursuing a PhD in Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering, or other related field
Must be enrolled in university for at least one semester following the internship
Expected graduation date between December 2027 – June 2028
Preferred Qualifications
Exposure to comminution processes
Experience with physical characterization techniques (flowability, adhesion, cohesion, bulk density, laser diffraction particle size determination)
Proficient in computational modeling techniques (e.g., fluid dynamics, discrete element method)

2027 Formulation Sciences Internship Overview

Join AbbVie's Pharmaceutical Technology team within Product Development, Science, and Technology (PDS&T) to support late-stage formulation development for a solid oral dosage form. Supporting Reliability Engineer as needed.

Currently enrolled in university, pursing a bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or other related field.
Must be enrolled in university for at least one semester following the co-op
Expected graduation date between December 2027 – June 2028

description:

Independently designs, reviews, and approves study-specific clinical label content and templates for global clinical studies, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant labeling that enables uninterrupted clinical supply. Applies expert judgment across label design, phrase-library governance, country requirements, vendor coordination, and change management within a validated label design system and a cGMP/GMP quality environment.
This is a proposed Grade 12 individual-contributor role integrating hands-on clinical label design with independent clinical label review and approval accountabilities. The role has broad global scope, owns quality and timelines for assigned work, and has no direct reports.
Key Responsibilities:
Review study protocols and related documentation to determine global clinical label requirements; partner with Clinical Supply Project Managers to evaluate label design options, supply needs, and implementation timelines.
Create, design, critically review, and approve study-specific and global clinical label templates—including single-panel and booklet labels—within the validated label design system.
Ensure label text, templates, and approvals comply with GMP/cGMP, applicable procedures, and global regulations for the United States, European Union, JAPAC, and other participating study countries.
Independently obtain, document, and maintain required approvals from Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, regional regulatory affiliates, and other designated stakeholders; resolve or escalate approval conflicts and compliance risks promptly.
Maintain the global clinical label phrase library: approve new controlled phrases, conduct annual reviews, maintain phrase quality and consistency, and execute phrase library change management, including impact assessments and implementation planning.
Maintain and update global and country-specific regulatory requirements in partnership with labeling leadership and regulatory stakeholders; assess requirements for new studies and booklet-label resupply.
Coordinate with third-party label vendors on booklet label orders, proof specifications, print readiness, and quality expectations; support label printing, reading, inspection, and timely release activities as required.
Review label and inventory impacts resulting from protocol, regulatory, or phrase changes; support inventory/resupply decisions and create destruction requests for expired or impacted inventory in accordance with procedures.
Manage multiple simultaneous studies and competing priorities with independent judgment, accurate status communication, and accountability for on-time, right-first-time delivery.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

Ability to interpret clinical protocols, apply regulatory requirements, produce accurate documentation, and exercise sound independent judgment in review and approval decisions.
Strong quality, analytical, organizational, project-management, communication, and issue-escalation skills; ability to manage simultaneous studies and timeline commitments.

3–5+ years of clinical trial design, clinical labeling, packaging, or pharmaceutical manufacturing experience.
Experience with validated label design systems, controlled phrase libraries, booklet labels, vendor proof review, inventory/resupply processes, and change management.
Experience collaborating with Clinical Supply, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Packaging, and third-party manufacturing or labeling vendors.

AbbVie Product Development Science & Technology – Biologics Analytical is a global analytical organization responsible for all CMC analytical activities related to the clinical development, commercialization, and on-market support of AbbVie's biological products. Our scope includes AbbVie's diverse pipeline of New Biological Entities (NBEs), including monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs), multispecific antibodies, Antibody Drug Conjugates (ADCs), and gene therapies and spans from clinical development to commercial product support. We are building a world-class team of scientists and leaders who will drive the advancement of industry-leading analytical capabilities and make meaningful contributions to advance AbbVie's pipeline of innovative medicines and ensure the commercial manufacturing success.
The Director will be responsible for leading a diverse team supporting AbbVie's pipeline which includes monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs), multispecific antibodies, Antibody Drug Conjugates (ADCs), gene therapies and other biologic products. You will lead the groups to drive the development of industry-leading analytical methods and control strategies to advance pipeline programs from clinical development through commercial manufacturing. You will partner cross-functionally to drive robust development of drug substances, drug products and combination products by enforcing rigorous risk management, applying Quality by Design (QbD), and providing key analytical support and insights.
The Director will ensure that all analytical deliverables are achieved within set timelines, budgets, and regulatory frameworks, while seamlessly integrating analytical and program strategies into broader business objectives. You will drive top-tier analytical method development and validation strategies, implementation of new technologies and automation. You will establish collaborative and productive working relationships with key partner organizations to define successful process development strategies. The Director will effectively manage interfaces to ensure seamless transition of research programs into late-stage clinical development and technology transfers to commercial manufacturing and testing sites.

Provides leadership, strategic guidance and talent development for groups of highly skilled analytical and pharmaceutical scientists who are responsible for global development programs and commercial support across AbbVie global network.
Defines and communicates industry-leading analytical strategies for mAbs, multi-specifics, ADCs and other potential new modalities.
Familiar with commercial manufacturing and QC testing and able to be a partner in strategic initiatives in the commercial space for modernization of manufacturing and quality controls.
Responsible for development, validation and transfer of analytical methods to support pipeline development and product life cycle management aligned with the strategies.
Establishes industry-leading analytical capabilities to support CMC process development, technology transfer and post-approval changes.
Solves difficult and highly complex technical issues in an evolving regulatory landscape.
Balances resources, resolves issues and achieves target timing for pipeline projects and key strategic initiatives.
Ensures scientific excellence and fosters functional, scientific, and professional development of staff.
Leads interactions with regulatory agencies in analytical development area and delivers regulatory filing packages.
Manages and develops scientific talent across multiple disciplines and/or projects to address current and future business needs.
Drives technical excellence and innovations in science that improve the capabilities and productivity of the organization.
Works collaboratively across R&D and Operations to align and influence a broad range of development strategies that directly support drug development programs.
Identifies, evaluates, and proposes both internal and external collaborations to drive scientific innovation and shared learning.
Accountable for compliance with Environmental Health and Safety regulations for the group.
PhD with at least 10 years of relevant pharma/biotech industry experience or master’s degree with at least 15 years of pharma/biotech experience.
Proven experience leading a CMC development organization, such as analytical development, drug substance, parenteral and/or combination products with a range of experience levels and scientific disciplines.
Skilled in analytical method development, validation, transfer and troubleshooting for biologics. Familiar with extended characterization to evaluate critical quality attributes (CQAs), assess process changes, and prove biosimilarity.
In depth knowledge in relevant regulations, interactions with regulatory agencies, and deep NDA and BLA experience with major responsibilities.
Extensive experience and solid understanding of the various scientific disciplines, including analytical control strategies, formulation development, regulatory filings, manufacturing, Quality Assurance (QA), and supply chain.
Demonstrated record of success leading strategic initiatives and new technology evaluation/implementation.
Track record on people management experience and leading matrix teams.
Strong oral and written communication skills.
Experience in motivating and maintaining positive morale of highly skilled technical individuals and teams in an environment where compliance with standard procedures is required.
Strong negotiating, influencing, and leadership skills.

Execution expectations: Execute product launches, promotional campaigns, merchandising updates, platform updates, and seasonal site changes
Performance Analytics: Analyze consumer behavior using all ecommerce reporting tools to identify growth opportunities. Analyze site traffic and sales data to provide regular reporting KPIs. Use these insights to recommend data-driven improvements to the user interface (UI), user experience (UX), promotional and merchandising strategy.
TikTok Shop oversight: support day to day management and partnership on affiliate model and site optimizations to align with DTC platforms.

Strong ability to project manage and collaborate with cross functional teams
Strong analytical, communication, and influencing skills

Ability to see the big picture, but obsess over the small details
Exceptional leadership skills and marketing savvy
Strong creative and conceptual thinking skills

Develop advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence models that support healthcare affordability and copay intelligence initiatives.

Design scoring frameworks, recommendation engines, and decision-support systems that enable proactive business actions.
Evaluate and implement modern AI methodologies, including machine learning, deep learning, ensemble methods, graph analytics, and Generative AI approaches.
Continuously improve model performance through experimentation, feedback loops, and performance monitoring.

Perform feature engineering, predictive modeling, forecasting, segmentation, optimization, and statistical analyses.
Assess and monitor model performance using both statistical and business outcome metrics.
Help translate ambiguous business questions into well-defined analytical problems, hypotheses, and success measures in partnership with business stakeholders.
Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Develop methodologies to measure business impact and return on investment for analytical solutions.

Partner with data engineering and technology teams to deploy machine learning solutions into production environments.
Apply sound practices for reproducibility, code quality, documentation, validation, and responsible AI throughout model development and deployment.
Design scalable and maintainable machine learning workflows and pipelines.
Implement model monitoring, automated retraining, model governance, and performance management processes.
Support development of enterprise AI products that can be scaled across multiple business functions.
Ensure solutions adhere to organizational standards for quality, privacy, security, and compliance.
Collaboration & Leadership
Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI and advanced analytics can drive measurable value.
Serve as a subject matter expert in data science, machine learning, and predictive analytics.
Present findings, recommendations, and technical concepts to senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
Communicate analytical trade-offs, limitations, and recommendations clearly to business, technical, and senior stakeholders.
Mentor junior data scientists and contribute to the growth of the broader analytics community.
Stay current on emerging technologies and industry trends in AI, machine learning, and healthcare analytics.

Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative discipline.
Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) is preferred but not required.
Equivalent combinations of education, specialized training, and relevant professional experience will be considered.
6+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning, artificial intelligence, or advanced analytics solutions in production environments.
Demonstrated experience delivering production data science solutions and evaluating their performance against business outcomes.

Hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
Experience building predictive, classification, forecasting, recommendation, or optimization models.

Experience working with large-scale data platforms and cloud-based environments.
Familiarity with MLOps, model deployment, model monitoring, and production AI practices.
Experience using modern software development and version control practices.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.
Demonstrated ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
Strong organizational and project management skills.
Passion for innovation, continuous learning, and practical application of AI technologies.

Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

The Biologics CMC Development team at AbbVie in the Bay Area has a long and rich history of biologics development. Located in a state-of-the-art facility in South San Francisco, the team leverages its comprehensive end-to-end CMC capabilities to work collaboratively through all phases of CMC development with a primary focus on advancing complex biologic therapies, such as multi-specifics, and novel modalities, to human clinical studies and eventual licensure. This role is within a team of highly experienced scientists and managers who have directly enabled the development/IND submissions of 20+ novel biologics and successfully filed two BLAs.
As a member of the CMC Purification Development group, you will apply strong downstream process-development expertise to design robust, phase-appropriate drug substance purification processes for GMP production, clinical studies, and eventual licensure. You will own purification deliverables for assigned programs, help define drug substance development strategy as a functional lead on cross-functional CMC teams, and communicate data-driven recommendations, risks, and tradeoffs to key stakeholders.
This position is an onsite role in a lab-based function. To be successful candidates must enjoy and thrive in a fast-paced and highly collaborative lab environment with daily face-to-face cross-functional interactions between scientists.
Responsibilities
Develop, optimize, characterize, and scale up purification processes for monoclonal antibodies, multispecifics, antibody-like molecules, and other complex biologic candidates across early- and late-stage drug substance process development
Lead technology transfer to internal or external GMP manufacturing sites; author transfer packages, support facility fit and readiness, and provide technical troubleshooting during clinical manufacturing
Develop viral clearance strategy and oversee studies with contract laboratories, including protocol development, technical review, data interpretation, and report approval
Optimize purification platforms and deepen process understanding through mechanistic modeling, statistical design of experiments, data analytics, and targeted wet-lab studies

Proven ability to work independently, effectively plan and execute work activities, and prioritize task completion to meet project deadlines in a fast-paced environment

description:

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. AbbVie's Immunology Discovery organization is seeking a highly motivated Senior Scientist I to join our Immune Profiling Systems Immunology team within the Discovery Immunology organization in Cambridge, Massachusetts. The successful candidate will contribute to the identification, validation, and prioritization of novel therapeutic targets for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases through the integration of experimental immunology and quantitative data analysis.
This role is ideal for a scientist who enjoys working at the interface of wet-laboratory experimentation and computational analysis. The candidate will design and execute human disease-relevant experiments, with an emphasis on complex in vitro models such as organoids or complex co-culture systems and their characterization using a range of high-throughput methodologies. They will generate high-dimensional datasets, analyze and interpret results, and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to advance discovery programs and portfolio decisions.
Key Responsibilities
Design, execute, and interpret immunology-focused experiments using primary human cells, PBMCs, tissues, and disease-relevant model systems.
Design and execute studies using complex in vitro models, including organoids or complex co-culture systems, and characterize these models using a range of high-throughput methodologies, such as multiplexed assays and sequencing-based profiling.
Develop and implement assays to characterize immune cell function, signaling pathways, cellular phenotypes, and therapeutic mechanisms of action.
Generate and analyze data from flow cytometry, cytokine profiling, NGS-based approaches, single-cell and spatial profiling workflows, and other molecular profiling platforms.
Partner with computational biologists, bioinformaticians, translational scientists, and disease-area teams to develop mechanistic insights and prioritize therapeutic targets.
Apply statistical and computational approaches to analyze complex datasets and communicate findings clearly to multidisciplinary audiences.
Maintain accurate experimental records and contribute to scientific reports, presentations, and project reviews.
Stay current with advances in immunology, translational research, systems biology, and emerging technologies and incorporate new approaches into discovery programs.
Present findings to project teams, leadership, and external scientific forums as appropriate.
Contribute to the scientific culture through collaboration, mentorship of junior scientists, and sharing of technical expertise.
BS/BA, MS, or PhD in in Immunology, Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, or a related scientific discipline with typically 0-3+ (PhD), 8-9+ (MS), or 10-11+ (BS) years of relevant academic and/or industry experience.
Strong scientific background in immunology and immune-mediated diseases.
Demonstrated expertise in experimental design, execution, and interpretation.
Hands-on experience working with primary human samples, including PBMCs, tissues, or disease-relevant cellular systems.
Hands-on experience working with complex in vitro models, such as organoids or complex co-culture systems, and applying high-throughput methodologies to characterize their cellular and functional properties.
Experience with immunological and molecular biology techniques such as flow cytometry, cell culture, ELISA/multiplex cytokine assays, gene expression analysis, and other functional assays.

description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
PURPOSE
The success of CDO depends on our ability to develop a holistic strategy and global network of exceptional PIs and institutions in order to accelerate delivery of our pipeline.  In an increasingly competitive landscape, strategic partnerships are critical to maximizing the solid tumor and hematology pipelines.  The Strategic Site Partner (SSP) serves as a key driver and main point of contact for our key partner sites and is passionate about establishing and strengthening strategic partnerships cross-functionally with key clinical sites in order to unlock operational potential and build strong, longitudinal relationships.
The SSP is responsible for adopting relationship management principles and critically thinking to better understand all business dimensions to impact and drive operational efficiencies in the conduct of AbbVie’s pipeline. In addition, they will align expectations between AbbVie and investigative site stakeholders proactively identifying opportunities to drive clinical trial accelerations and efficiencies at the study and/or program level.
The SSP is responsible for engaging internal leaders at all levels to maximally leverage aligned collaborations cross functionally with a goal of enabling alliances to deliver results consistent with strategic goals and to enhance AbbVie’s relationships to secure the company's reputation as a Partner of Choice.
The Strategic Site Partner reports to the Director, Strategic Site Partnership .

Provides input and develop the site-specific engagement strategy for assigned sites.
Builds and manages relationships with assigned investigative sites through a white-glove service. approach while meeting with Institution Leadership, Principal Investigator and clinical site staff both on-site and remotely.
Raises the bar to proactively anticipate a site’s needs and drives timely mitigation strategies.
Maintains a solution-oriented mindset to facilitate resolution of complex operational issues.
Remains informed of best practices and innovations that have resulted in efficiencies across the business and/or industry and put actions in place that support the organization in removing identified barriers.

description:

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
The Community You Will Join:
The Airbnb Hotels team is a fun, fast-growing group leading Airbnb’s expansion into the hotel sector. Operating with an entrepreneurial spirit, this team combines the simplicity, product excellence, and guest-centered ethos that define Airbnb. This team’s mission is to deliver the smoothest, most intuitive hotel booking experience for guests, while helping hotels easily drive incremental bookings so they can focus on delivering the best hospitality. The ultimate aim is to help more people discover high-quality hotels, creating value for guests and our hotel partners.
The Difference You Will Make:
We’re looking for an experienced Connectivity Partner Manager to own the health and growth of our network of connectivity providers, including channel managers, property management systems (PMS), central reservation systems (CRS) and other integration partners. You’ll join the Global Hotels Connectivity team, which owns Airbnb’s global relationships with hotel connectivity providers. Using data, automation, and scaled programs, you’ll keep your portfolio integrated and compliant, improving connection quality and operations in close partnership with internal stakeholders.
The ideal candidate is a technical expert with strong project management experience, analytical acumen, and excellent communication skills.

Own end-to-end connection performance across a network of connectivity partners, delivering day-to-day support through scaled programs.
Build deep knowledge of technical integrations across PMS, CRS and Channel Managers, to provide targeted partner support.
Use data to identify strategic opportunities and drive growth.
Own scaled communications to all partners on feature updates, mandatory API changes, and deprecations, with clear timelines and next steps.
Educate partners on product updates and share partner feedback with internal stakeholders.
Troubleshoot partner technical issues to ensure performance.
Develop and maintain technical partner resources that support field teams to self-serve.
Represent Airbnb at external meetings and industry events, engaging with connectivity and hotel partners.
Work with your team to design and manage projects that support the commercial goals of Airbnb and our hotel and connectivity partners.

6+ years of experience in a Connectivity Partner Manager or Technical Partner Manager role within a global technology or hospitality tech company.
Strong understanding of hospitality/travel software; PMS, CRS, Channel Managers.
Proficiency in SQL, Looker and Excel.
Tableau, Asana, Jira  and Salesforce experience preferred.
Solid technical troubleshooting skills and project management experience.
Excellent communication and presentation abilities, with confidence in engaging clients across multiple channels with stakeholders at various levels.
Effective time management and ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment.
Strong quantitative skills with a proven ability to leverage data in decision-making.
Adaptability to shifting priorities, projects, and deadlines.
Passion for Airbnb, travel, and the sharing economy—being an Airbnb host is a plus

title: Design Program Manager, Enterprise, Worldwide Grocery Retail Growth & Development (WWRGD)
description:

You will define the standards and toolkits that make design delivery repeatable at scale, and you will be the senior design voice for the program, ensuring every project is grounded in strong design thinking and delivered efficiently. title: Energy Analytics, TPM, Global Energy, Sustainability and Automation
description:
The Energy Analytics, Technical Program Manager (TPM) will scale power monitoring, insight generation, and energy and carbon reduction initiatives across Amazon's North America fulfillment operations. In this hands-on technical role, you will deploy and generate analysis from power metering infrastructure and implement load flexibility and energy optimization roadmaps that deliver measurable cost savings and carbon reductions. This work directly supports Amazon's demand-side power requirements and Climate Pledge commitments.
You will operate as an individual contributor, owning the delivery of defined and ambiguous work-streams while partnering with engineering, controls, data, operations and deployment teams to implement changes. You will influence cross-functional partners without authority, primarily at the team and management level, using data to drive decisions. You will integrate and analyze power metering information, providing load forecasts and generating cost and energy savings opportunities. Utility rate structures, time of day, demand ratchets and power factor penalties will influence your strategies. Technical assets influenced can include material handling, robotics, powered industrial trucks, lighting, heating ventilation and air conditioning, plug loads, electrical metering and more. Developed projects will be scaled across hundreds of facilities across the network, producing energy, cost and carbon benefit.
Key job responsibilities
● Build and execute technical solutions for energy and carbon reduction from pilot, data collection, through scaled implementation and measurement & verification (M&V) of results.  Energy and load optimization via control systems is a technical requirement: energy-conservation/standby modes, variable speed applications, and equipment scheduling.
● Drive continuous monitoring and energy efficiency improvements with Amazon's energy consuming assets.  Integrate power metering into our data sets, and develop analytics to identify opportunities, assess trending consumption changes, and measure benefits of conservation efforts.
● Prepare written analysis of feasibility studies and recommendations for various energy monitoring and power flexibility strategies.  Own metering data quality programs, check readings for completeness, outliers, and flag actionable improvements, and reconcile against known loads to ensure trusted insight generation.
● Develop metrics, baselines, and roadmaps that translate technical work into quantified outcomes (energy savings, cost savings or utility tariff arbitrage, load forecast, reliability, carbon reduction).
● Define and own technical approach and cross-system architecture for data configuration, standards and mechanisms for scalability and enforcement of key energy savings mechanisms. Decide how to build and prove new approaches managing tradeoffs for necessary business needs, rather than executing a defined scope.
● Manage projects against plans and objectives to ensure commitments are met, delivering against our power and Climate Pledge goals.
● Deep diving (troubleshooting) and unblocking issues that are prohibiting teams from pursuing energy reduction initiatives.
● Work with critical stakeholders on developing mechanisms for design standard integration for launching facilities that incorporate energy optimization procedures from Day 1.
● Analyze and communicate the financial impact of projects and initiatives (payback, return on investment, net present value)
● Serve as a technical reviewer for peers and partner engineers — reviewing control logic, metering architecture, and design-standard changes, and improving them on technical merit
● Quantify and own value add of energy savings mechanisms and how they reduce equipment runtime and increases reliability and lifespan.
● Calculate and report energy, water and carbon savings using International Performance Measurement and Verification Protocol methodologies.
● Manage multiple, complex projects simultaneously.
● Produce clear documentation, playbooks, and reporting that make work-streams repeatable.
A day in the life
You might spend the morning querying newly integrated power-metering data and validating it against the distribution-panel hierarchy — resolving a data-quality gap — then analyzing load profiles and build an energy-savings or peak-shaving model that quantifies the opportunity by equipment class. You then define network rollout suitability and prioritize these opportunities across sites. In the afternoon you develop control logic changes to implement an efficiency opportunity, propose updates to a design standard, or define a measurement method for implemented energy and cost savings to your stakeholders. You balance trade-offs between energy savings, technical complexity, equipment reliability, and cost — bringing well-reasoned recommendations and escalating the most ambiguous decisions for alignment.
About the team
The Global Energy, Sustainability and Automation (GESA) Energy team is dedicated to delivering energy efficiency, cost savings, and demand flexibility within Amazon's fulfillment network. We partner closely with design, controls, data, procurement, operations, field engineering, and deployment teams — as well as external vendors — to ensure our energy consumption is monitored and optimized. Our focus in the coming years is scaling our energy monitoring and analytics programs, expanding behavioral and retrofit programs, expanding load flexibility for power resilience and cost arbitrage benefit, and enhancing asset reliability and lifespan through efficient operation. If you are energized by large-scale technical challenges and want to make a tangible impact on energy use, this is the team for you.
Basic qualifications: - 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
- Experience in SQL Server/MySQL, or experience in Redshift and experience in any Bigdata architecture
- Experience working with existing and emerging technologies related to building energy (i.e. power metering, conveyance, robotics, controls, HVAC, charging infrastructure)
Preferred qualifications: - Experience managing cross-functional programs and release schedules
- Familiarity with automation engineering and controls engineering concepts.

title: Principal Program Manager, WHS Strategy, Workplace Health and Safety
description:
Amazon's Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) organization is responsible for safeguarding the health and wellbeing of more than 1.2 million operations employees across Amazon's global operations network. WHS advances safety performance through three pillars: people, programs, and technology. The organization builds a self-sustaining safety culture, prevents incidents through engineering and standardized operational practices, and applies artificial intelligence and computer vision to drive faster, proactive safety interventions at scale.
We are seeking a Principal Program Manager to lead the WHS Strategy team. This is a high-visibility leadership role at the intersection of enterprise strategy, executive communications, and operational safety performance. The leader in this position will serve as the primary owner of WHS's strategic planning cycle and will be accountable for the quality, coherence, and timeliness of the safety narrative presented to Amazon's most senior executives, including VP, SVP, and Board-level audiences.
This role requires a strategic leader who is effective under pressure, comfortable navigating organizational complexity, and capable of exercising sound judgment on matters with broad impact. The right candidate brings deep experience partnering directly with executive leadership, the ability to bring structure to ambiguous problems, and a consistent track record of delivering on high-stakes commitments. A core requirement is the ability to take complex, technical safety programs and communicate them with clarity and simplicity to audiences ranging from front-line operators to Board members. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills are not a differentiator for this role; they are a baseline requirement.
Key job responsibilities
This leader will own the end-to-end strategic planning lifecycle for WHS, including the development of 1 to 3 year strategic roadmaps, annual operating plans (OP1/OP2), and recurring executive reviews at monthly, quarterly, and annual cadences. Specific accountabilities include:
Collecting, synthesizing, and integrating strategic inputs from WHS teams across the organization, then drafting that content into a single, unified voice that reflects the WHS leader's perspective, ensuring consistent messaging, tone, and narrative alignment from document to document.
Authoring and managing the portfolio of WHS executive-level documents, ensuring analytical rigor, narrative precision, and strategic alignment across every deliverable that represents WHS to senior leadership.
Partnering with operations, engineering, and technology organizations across Amazon to integrate health and safety priorities into their strategic plans, influencing outcomes without direct authority.
Designing and governing the mechanisms through which safety data is reported to leadership, including ownership of data lock processes that ensure consistency and accuracy across all executive-facing materials.
Identifying opportunities to modernize how safety performance data is visualized, shared, and consumed by decision-makers at every level, raising the standard for insight-driven reporting.
Managing the enterprise planning calendar and orchestrating cross-functional inputs from a broad coalition of WHS field teams, central program teams, and operations stakeholders globally.
Translating complex operational programs, technical initiatives, and nuanced safety concepts into clear, concise, and accessible content for executive and non-specialist audiences.
A day in the life
You are a results-oriented leader with a genuine intellectual curiosity about what drives safety performance in complex operational environments. You combine strategic thinking with operational discipline: you can frame a multi-year vision and then build the mechanisms to bring it to life. You are comfortable being the person in the room who is expected to have the answer, and you hold yourself to that standard.
You bring a data-driven approach to every decision, an instinct for continuous improvement, and the organizational fluency to move work forward across teams that do not report to you. You are energized by ambiguity, not paralyzed by it. You communicate with clarity and economy, recognizing that at the executive level, every word carries weight. You are ready to own the strategic direction of safety for one of the world's largest employers and to ensure that direction is understood, aligned, and acted upon from the front line to the boardroom.
This is an in-office role requiring five days per week on-site. Travel is expected at 10 to 20 percent annually.
About the team

You spend your day building the organization's capacity to change. You partner with leadership to shape the change strategy, then own how it comes to life: assessing why change stalls and fixing it at the root rather than rescuing one rollout at a time. You sequence a portfolio of concurrent changes so the organization adopts them without saturating, and build the methodology and standards that let every team run change well. title: Technical Program Manager, Fauna
description:
Fauna Robotics is looking for a Technical Program Manager to own quality for robot behavior and data collection. You will write and maintain the test suite that every release and every new policy goes through. That suite has two layers. The first is a core set of regression tests that confirms, every time, that the robot's locomotion, manipulation, mode transitions, and autonomy hand-offs still behave as expected. The second, and harder, layer goes looking for the subtle problems a routine pass will miss: failures that appear only in particular sequences of events, under particular loads, or in the interaction between the operator, the teleoperation stack, and the robot. You will run these tests yourself on experimental hardware, write clear and reproducible reports, and work with the engineering teams until each issue is understood and resolved.
You will also help keep the data we collect at a high quality through hands-on, on-site work with the robots: supporting benchmark collections, reviewing recorded episodes, and tracking data problems back to their root cause, whether that's the operator, the teleoperation stack, the robot, or the pipeline. As new collection tasks come out of research, you'll pilot them on hardware with the data scientists who designed them, validate the tools and methods they depend on, and say whether they're ready to run at scale. You'll be the go-to person for bringing new data collectors and QA team members up to speed on our teleoperation stack, our data collection management and ingestion tools, and the basics of finding, triaging, and reporting bugs.
Key job responsibilities
- Own the release test suite for robot behavior and teleoperation. Write, maintain, and run test plans for updates to the teleoperation stack, internal and external software releases, and new robot policies.
- Maintain a repeatable core regression suite that every change must pass, and extend it with deeper, adversarial test cases designed to surface subtle, intermittent, or interaction-dependent failures across the operator, the teleoperation stack, and the robot.
- Run tests hands-on with experimental robots and in simulation. Write detailed, reproducible test reports and bug reports, and give clear go/no-go recommendations for each release and each new policy.
- Track issues through to resolution with software, controls, hardware, and ML teams. Keep a record of known issues, how to reproduce them, and workarounds.
- Support data quality through hands-on, on-robot testing: help run benchmark collections, review recordings against task requirements, flag problem episodes, and feed the failure patterns you find back to the teams that own the process and tooling.
- Pilot new data collection tasks alongside data scientists and research engineers: translate research intent into an executable protocol, run the first sessions yourself, and report back on feasibility, throughput, and data quality.
- Validate the data collection tools and methods behind each task before they're relied on at scale — define acceptance criteria, quantify failure modes, and make the go/no-go call. Iterate on task setups, scene design, and annotation schemas where the data doesn't hold up.
- Onboard and mentor new data collectors and QA team members on our teleoperation stack, the data collection management system, the ingestion and annotation tools, and how to report bugs well.
- Coordinate the day-to-day test and benchmark activities that data collectors take part in. Work with the data collection program manager, who owns the data collectors' work and priorities, to schedule robot time, sessions, and test coverage.
- Assess the spaces and resources that testing and collection depend on — lab and home-like environments, robot availability, headsets and peripherals, fixtures and props — and flag what's missing before it becomes a bottleneck.
Keep test documentation, checklists, SOPs, and run books up to date as the robot, the app, and our policies change.
Work safely around experimental hardware, and hold the people you train to the same standard.
About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.
Basic qualifications: - 3+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- 3+ years of experience in quality assurance, test, or validation of hardware or hardware-plus-software products (robotics, consumer electronics, automotive, aerospace, XR, or similar), or in technical program management for such products
- Experience writing and running structured test plans and SOPs, and producing detailed, reproducible test and bug reports with logs, timestamps, media, and system context
- Experience working hands-on with physical robots or other experimental hardware in a lab or test environment, including diagnosing failures that span hardware, firmware, and software
- Experience teleoperating robots, or extensive hands-on use of VR/XR headsets
- Linux and command-line proficiency — able to run scripts and terminal tooling to drive, inspect, and debug hardware directly
- Able to work in a VR headset for extended sessions (multiple hours at a time) and to work safely around experimental robots, which includes standing, moving, and occasionally lifting equipment
- Able to lift up to 10 lbs and wear equipment weighing up to 30 lbs; continuous hand/eye coordination, fine manipulation, and kinesthetic awareness
- Experience training, onboarding, or mentoring others on technical tools or processes
- Ability to write technical documentation precise enough for an operator or support agent to follow without the author present
Preferred qualifications: - 3+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- Experience teleoperating robots with a Meta Quest 3 (or a similar VR teleoperation setup)
- Experience with robot learning data collection, such as demonstration data, episode annotation, or dataset quality review
- Experience validating robot control or learned policies on hardware before release
- Experience leading QA across a hardware, firmware, and software product ecosystem, including fleet-level validation testing and catching performance regressions before release
- Python scripting for hardware control; firmware flashing and diagnostic interfaces; electromechanical diagnostics (motors, sensors, thermal systems)
- Experience using LLMs or AI coding tools to build simple internal tools such as dashboards, web UIs, or report generators to speed up QA work
- Familiarity with issue trackers and test management tools, and with reading logs or telemetry to narrow down a failure
- Experience coordinating the daily work of operators or test technicians without being their direct manager
- Experience owning production incidents or executive escalations end-to-end in unfamiliar system architecture

Strong software engineering skills and programming in C++.

Excellent communication and experience working with multi-functional teams.

title: Coordination SRE
description:
Apple’s Services Engineering organization (ASE) is seeking experienced distributed systems engineers to join our Coordination SRE team. Engineers in ASE Coordination SRE develop and contribute to software built to manage Apache Zookeeper and ETCD, both open source distributed coordination and state management systems which are used to power some of Apple’s most critical internet services. You will be joining a team of experts, working at the cutting edge of modern distributed system deployment architectures. The team’s work is deployed at massive scale in data-centers worldwide, forming a platform upon which iCloud and many other internet services at Apple are built. In ASE, your work will benefit hundreds of millions of users and is critical to the success of Apple cloud infrastructure technologies.
The ASE Coordination SRE team develops applications and tooling that are safe, reliable, scalable, and fast. Team members contribute to all major components of Coordination Systems deployment infrastructure, including maintenance automation, monitoring and alerting tooling/dashboards, deployment architecture, as well as contributing back to the upstream patches to the database focused on stability, performance, and scaling. As a distributed team, ability to work optimally with colleagues based in other locations is also essential; experience in this area is a plus. Come join us at Apple Services Engineering and help us deliver services and applications that are fluid and responsive. This role is for engineers who enjoy deep technical engineering that spans large cross-organizational projects. Your openness to learning and implementing new technologies will contribute to the continuous evolution of our organization.
Minimum qualifications: BS or MS in Computer Science / related fields or equivalent work experience
Understanding of core SRE concepts - Monitoring, Alerting, Incident management. Proficient in one or more of the following programming languages: Java, Go (golang), Python
Understanding of database concepts (consistency models, isolation levels, crash and recovery semantics).
Performance engineering (design concepts, profile-guided optimization).
Operating systems concepts (process scheduling, disk and network I/O, performance).
Datacenter architecture (networking topologies, host placement strategies, and failure modes); design of multi-datacenter systems; failure domains; and wide-area networking.

Optional experience with EC2, EBS, and Terraform
Service management and migrations across bare metal, virtualized (EC2), and Kubernetes platforms.
Fundamentals of system-level hardware and networking components (storage devices and controllers, network interfaces, CPU and memory layout in server-class systems).
Demonstrated expertise developing database systems, storage engines, distributed systems, or performance engineering.

title: Data Scientist, Apple Pay
description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other's ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist with the intellectual curiosity and strategic depth to reimagine how Apple Pay measures and optimizes its marketing. You don't wait to be handed a question; you identify the questions worth asking, conceptualize the right framework to answer them, and propose approaches that others haven't considered yet. You know the marketing and media landscape deeply: how marketing mix models quantify cross-channel marketing effectiveness using statistical or econometric models, how incrementally testing from geo-based experiments to causal inference methods — isolates true causal lift, and how behavioral signals derived from clustering, propensity modeling, or sequence analysis can shape smarter audience strategies and campaign design. What sets you apart is the ability to architect the right measurement framework before a single model is built, identifying the causal assumptions that need to hold, the confounders that need to be controlled for, and the experimental conditions that will make results actionable. AI/ML is the tool you bring to take those frameworks to a level of rigor, scale, and speed that wouldn't otherwise be possible whether that means building production-grade causal inference pipelines, designing ML-powered experiment analysis, or applying LLMs to accelerate how insights are generated and communicated.

• Proficiency in applying ML techniques to marketing and customer datasets
• Strong proficiency in Python and data science libraries (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels, or equivalent)

• Familiarity with Generative AI and large language models, and comfort integrating AI tools into day-to-day analytical workflows
• Strong written and verbal communication skills and are able to tell compelling stories with data to both technical and non-technical audiences
Preferred qualifications: • Experience with paid media data across channels, paid digital, in-store media, social, and other performance marketing platforms
• Experience with awareness and performance marketing measurement
• Actively follows industry trends in marketing science and media measurement — aware of emerging methodologies and tools and brings those perspectives into the team
• Experience applying Generative AI to marketing workflows, including budget optimization, automated creative analysis, or campaign performance reporting
• Advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Statistics, Machine Learning, Econometrics, Marketing Science, or a related quantitative field

title: Design Verification Engineer
description:
At Apple, we work every single day to craft products that enrich people’s lives. Do you love working on challenges that no one has solved yet and changing the game? We have an opportunity for an outstandingly hardworking design verification engineer! As a member of our wide-ranging group, you will have the rare and extraordinary opportunity to craft upcoming products that will delight and encourage millions of Apple’s customers daily.
This role is for a DV engineer who will enable us to produce fully functional first silicon for IP designs. The responsibilities include all phases of pre-silicon verification including but not limited to: establishing DV methodology, test-plan development, verification environment development including stimulus and checkers, test-writing, debug, coverage, sign-off for RTL freeze and tape-out.
In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring bug-free first silicon for part of the SoC / IP and are encouraged to develop detailed test and coverage plans based on the micro-architecture. You are responsible for developing verification methodology suitable for the IP, ensuring a scalable and portable environment. You will get to develop verification environment, including all the respective components such as stimulus, checkers, assertions, trackers, coverage. A mindset to break the design is highly desirable.
Furthermore, you will develop verification plans for all features under your care, execute verification plans, including design bring-up, DV environment bring- up, regression enabling features, and debug of the test failures. You will also learn to develop block, IP and SoC level test-benches track and report DV progress using a variety of metrics, including bugs and coverage. You will also be expected to make use of LLM and related technologies to achieve efficient execution and improved quality.
Minimum qualifications: BS degree in technical subject area with minimum 10 years of proven experience or equivalent.
Preferred qualifications: Deep knowledge of OOP, SystemVerilog and UVM
Deep knowledge in developing scalable and portable test-benches
Strong experience with verification methodologies and tools such as simulators, waveform viewers, Build and run automation, coverage collection, gate level simulations
Working experience using LLMs for efficiency and quality
Experience with power-aware (UPF) or similar verification methodology
Excellent knowledge of one of the scripting languages such as Python, Perl, TCL
Experience with serial protocols such as PCIe or USB, parallel protocol such as DDR is a plus but not required
Knowledge of formal verification methodology is a plus but not required
Knowledge of emulation for verification technologies is a plus but not required

title: Display Module Engineer
description:

This individual will serve as a focal point in driving new display technology development and implementation of critical technology platforms to improve display performance, from design conception to hardware and experience prototyping, and to final products. You will be a directly responsible individual to collaborate with multi-functional teams on prototyping efforts for architecture definition, work with suppliers to understand design tolerance and sensitivities, optimize system-level performance based on critical metrics, and validate system designs through engineering builds and design of experiments.

You will be part of something big; come join us!

Experience in one or more of the following : optical design and characterization, optical simulation, physical and geometrical optics, semiconductor optoelectronics, display technologies, sensors, technologies and statistical analysis
Experience leading engineering builds, planning test activities, and managing readiness of module deliverables across development phases
Experience with tools for data acquisition and analysis (Python, LabVIEW), statistical analysis (JMP, MATLAB), and optical simulation (LightTools, FDTD, Zemax, Code V) is strongly desired
Hands-on experience with optical and electrical measurement systems for characterization, testing and validation
Preferred qualifications: MS, or PhD in EE, Optics, Physics, Materials Science, or a related field with 3 years of industry experience
Experience with different display technologies (transmissive, emissive, reflective etc), LED illumination design, fundamental understanding of optics and device physics are a big plus in driving architecture definition and convergence
Experience in module engineering, module integration, or high-volume manufacturing processes. Direct mass-production experience is highly beneficial

title: Display Technologist
description:
Apple's Hardware Technologies team develops the innovative displays that define our products and delight our customers worldwide. The Panel Technologies team is at the forefront of developing display technology that pushes the boundaries of what's possible. Join our team and help create the generation of display experiences that will wow customers around the globe!
Our work centers on the intricate relationship between OLED (organic light-emitting diodes) and thin-film transistor backplanes in modern displays. These complex interactions require deep technical understanding and innovative solutions. As a Display Technologist on our team, you will be participating in display design process and algorithms development that enable breakthrough display technologies while ensuring both performance and reliability.
This role requires someone who thrives on complex technical challenges without precedents. You will need understanding of sophisticated electro-optical systems and translate that knowledge into practical design and algorithmic solutions. This position breaks down multifaceted display physics problems into solvable components and implementing solutions that balance cutting-edge performance with product longevity.
Strong analytical thinking and creative problem-solving are essential. We require expertise in thin film wave optics and geometric optics, combined with data processing and visualization capability and statistical frameworks to extract meaningful insights from complex display performance datasets.
Collaboration is key to success in this role. Candidate will be expected to collaborate closely not only with other Display Engineering teams, but also teams outside the Display Engineering such as Silicon design, Software Engineering, and manufacturing partners. Communicating technical findings to various audiences is needed while translating complex concepts into actionable engineering decisions.
Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Physics, Optics, Material Science, or Electrical Engineering
Experience in Python and MATLAB for large-scale data collection and analysis
Experience in thin film wave optics / geometric optics modeling
Preferred qualifications: MS or PhD degree
Deep understanding of OLED device principles
Experience with the latest consumer electronics display technologies
Ability to communicate technical problems and challenges clearly and effectively across cross-functional organizations

title: Engineering Manager, Private Cloud Compute Inference Routing
description:
At Apple, iCloud Platform Engineering builds the server stack behind Push Notifications, iMessage, FaceTime, iCloud, iCloud Private Relay and Private Cloud Compute (PCC), the backbone of Siri AI and Apple Intelligence. We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead PCC inference routing. These systems send every inference request to the right compute across a global, multi-region fleet, while keeping latency low, availability high and PCC's privacy guarantees intact.
This is a technically grounded leadership role for someone who thrives at scale, can bring clarity to complex and fast-changing environments, and is energized by building both systems and teams. You'll guide architectural direction, scale operational practices and develop the engineers and leaders who will shape how Apple delivers cloud inference.
Routing LLM inference at Apple's scale takes systems that adapt to changing demand, available capacity and failures while keeping latency low and accelerator utilization high. As the fleet grows across regions and cells, routing must account for capacity and health across the whole fleet, not just a single site. PCC adds a basic architectural requirement: request content stays encrypted outside trusted compute nodes. You'll lead the design of routing and scheduling strategies within this privacy model. Together with inference and security teams, you'll evaluate techniques such as cache-aware request placement and prefill/decode disaggregation. Your scope includes the inference AI gateway layer, where requests are authenticated, metered, prioritized and streamed back to clients, all without exposing request content.
This work has broad reach. Every improvement to routing makes Siri AI and Apple Intelligence faster and more reliable, and makes better use of Apple's inference capacity. In your first year, you'll be expected to grow a high-performing organization, set a clear technical roadmap, and measurably improve routing latency, availability and fleet utilization.

title: Software Engineer - Generative UI, Input Experience
description:
A generated interface is only as good as the pieces it's made from. Give a model the wrong pieces and it fails, producing something generic or broken. Give it the right ones and it can make something a designer would be proud of.
We're looking for an engineer with a designer's eye to build those pieces: the views, layouts, and APIs that generated interfaces are built from. The goal is to make the right result the easy one to write, for people and models.
You'll join a small, newly formed team working closely with Apple's design studio, and you'll own the UI layer that generative interfaces are built on. Your APIs will have two kinds of users: engineers, and the models generating interfaces in real time. Most of the work is finding the right abstraction. Which layout decisions should a view make by itself? Which should be stated as intent? Which should never be exposed at all? An API that answers those questions well lets a model write a few lines and get something that feels native.
The hard cases are the ones designers usually solve by hand: tight space, many sizes, content whose length and shape aren't known until it arrives. You'll build components that handle them without anyone drawing each one.
With designers, you'll prototype quickly until something feels right, then turn it into a principled, well-named API with a small surface. With the generation side, you'll study how models use your APIs and change them until good results are the default. Along the way you'll partner with design, AI, and UI framework teams across Apple.
Minimum qualifications: 5+ years of software engineering experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
Expert-level SwiftUI, including custom Layout and preferences, with a deep understanding of its layout model
Designed and shipped a reusable view or component API that other engineers adopted
A portfolio, shipped work, or prototypes that show strong visual craft, especially typography and layout
Comfortable working directly with designers, from early ambiguous exploration through to a pixel-exact result

title: Systems Engineer - Evaluation Engineering
description:

We are looking for a Distributed Systems Engineer to own the infrastructure powering our core

Experience building Agentic RAG platforms or developer-facing infrastructure tooling.

title: Technical Product Marketing Specialist, Canada & Latin America
description:

Experience with mass deployment techniques and best practices for iOS and macOS, as well as large-scale system administration
Strong knowledge of the macOS command line toolset, shell scripting, Python, and modern web technology codebases
Fluency in written and spoken English

A solution-oriented mindset and high-level programming skills
Excellent written and spoken communication skills, and the ability to tailor communication to different audiences
Experience building scalable databases
A creative and ambitious approach to problem-solving

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

title: Technical Program Manager - Image Sensor & Process Integration
description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.
Here at Apple we don’t just create products — we create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of our people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Product Operations at Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.
You will take the lead in driving continuous improvement activities for semiconductor device processes during product development, ramp up and throughout the product lifetime. You will work with Apple’s internal engineering team, our semiconductor device vendors and downstream with module and system integrators.
The scope covers image sensor devices used in all modules and all systems. And, the right candidate will work across multiple locations in various continents with on-site visits with our vendors.
Minimum qualifications: 7 + years technical understanding of semiconductor devices, involving problem solving and issue root cause analysis / data analysis in a pressured environment
MS / PhD in Electrical Engineering, semiconductor devices, or allied technical subject
Preferred qualifications: Interpersonal skills of leadership, communication, teamwork, project management, and influencing.
Flexibility: Evening and weekends work will be required. The job also requires international travel.
Good working knowledge of semiconductor devices and associated module components is preferred (e.g. silicon processing or III-V, etc.).
Understanding of semiconductor processes (etch, litho, etc.) wafer test, yield, wafer fab process integration, wafer packaging, back-end issues.
Familiarity with quality systems and quality control.

title: Test & Instrumentation Development Engineer
description:
The Instrumentation and Test technology team architects and designs best-in-class, end-to-end test and measurements systems.
We are a collaborative group of creative and thoughtful people developing highly complex and sophisticated systems to validate the performance of sensors and other critical technologies in our world-class products.
This individual will play a key role in designing comprehensive test strategies, methodologies, and integrating the measurement systems to support new product introduction, characterization, ramp, and mass production. This includes everything from defining high level test plans to architecting the specific instruments required to execute them.
You will play a key role in architecting, designing, and deploying the complete test solutions—including hardware, software, and algorithms—for our next-generation products. Partnering closely with a wide range of cross-functional teams, you will develop the critical test methodologies and instrumentation needed for system characterization, calibration, and validation in a fast-paced and collaborative product development environment.
Minimum qualifications: Our ideal candidate has experience in test integration, implementation, and has a strong foundation in at least one of the following core areas: system or application-level test software or instrumentation hardware design.
Minimum of bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (EE), Electrical & Computer Engineering (ECE) with 10 years of relevant industry experience in a hands-on technical role.
3+ years of experience in a programming language like C/C++ or Python
Preferred qualifications: End-to-end Test Design: Experience creating and documenting comprehensive test plans, defining test cases and coverage, and developing validation methodologies for complex systems.
International Travel: This role requires international travel (up to 25%) to support our manufacturing partners during key product builds. This typically involves 2-4 trips per year at sites in Asia. Our team is committed to providing as much advance notice as possible to support your planning.
Curiosity and Adaptability: You are driven by curiosity, energized by solving novel problems, and motivated to learn new skills to get the job done.
Focused Problem Solving: You excel at identifying the most critical variables in a complex system and can develop a clear, focused plan of action even when all the details are not yet available.
Hands-on experience with electronics debugging tools.
Electrical engineering fundamentals (ability to read schematics & layout & component datasheets).
You have experience developing robust software and algorithms in a modern object-oriented or scripting language (e.g., Python, C++). Familiarity with the Apple ecosystem is a plus but not required.
Background in testing high-volume consumer electronics, particularly with Touch, Sensing, Display, or other complex user-facing technologies.
Knowledge of digital signal processing (DSP) or image processing algorithms.
Experience with instrument camera and optical capture system is a plus.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to collaborate with cross-functional engineering and design teams.
Passion for learning and contributing across disciplines.
Analytical Problem-Solving: Excellent skills in debugging and performing failure analysis across software, hardware and system domains. Experience with structured problem-solving methodologies like Design of Experiments (DOE). Ability to perform and interpret statistical data analysis.
Master's degree preferred.

title: US-Business Pro
description:

Have extensive business solutions experience with Apple products and services.
Be proficient in the local language, both written and spoken (sign language supported).

description:
